| **Acceptance Rate** | Multiple independent first-hand author reports on Daily Nous (Jan 2024 'Notably Good Experiences with Philosophy Journals' thread) describe SJP favorably: one author was rejected but received the decision '2 months to the day' after submission with helpful comments from 2 reviewers; another received an R&R decision and reported the editor (Remy Debes) personally helped sharpen prose and honored the original reviewer assignment even after a ~6-month author-side delay; a third lists SJP among journals giving 'helpful, quick feedback' even on rejections, calling it 'an amazing bright spot in our profession.' Of revised/conditional submissions in the APA Survey (n=26), 76.92% were ultimately accepted. | WO2 (see Reviewer Pool Characteristics sources) |
| **Desk Rejection Rate** | Not separately broken out from full rejections. APA Survey initial-verdict breakdown (n=99): reject 69.70%, R&R 21.21%, conditional accept 7.07%, outright accept 2.02%. Wiley's own official 'Acceptance Rate' metric (all stages combined) = 12%. These are two different metrics (initial-verdict-reject vs final-acceptance-rate) and are not directly comparable — presented separately rather than merged. | WO2 |

| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — WO2 defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |

| **Summary** | 無法直接讀取 Wiley 官方 AI 政策原文頁(403/402),但期刊本身的 Author Guidelines 頁面完全未提及 AI/生成式 AI 字樣——SJP 未制定期刊專屬政策,適用 Wiley 出版社統一政策。二手來源(圖書館 LibGuide)摘要該政策:允許 AI 輔助語言潤飾、結構建議、文獻分類、程式碼協助,但須在 Methods/Acknowledgments 揭露工具名稱與用途;禁止 AI 列名作者、禁止用 AI 生成或竄改研究數據/圖表、禁止未經查證的 AI 生成內容(摘要/結果/結論)。屬「有條件允許+強制揭露」,故 gate=conditional、leniency=3(非全禁,非完全開放)。這是出版社層級政策,非 SJP 期刊層級首次驗證,故 signal_quality 偏低。 |

### Preprint Policy

> WO2 research note (not broken down per-stage — see docs/workorders/WO2_SOFT_METADATA_BATCH.md for why): Yes, per Wiley's standard (non-journal-specific) self-archiving policy: submitted/preprint version may be self-archived at any time on non-commercial preprint servers; accepted (peer-reviewed) version may be self-archived after an embargo (SSH journals typically 24 months). No SJP-specific preprint statement was found — this is inferred from generic Wiley self-archiving policy, not a page verified as SJP-specific.
> Source: https://authors.wiley.com/author-resources/Journal-Authors/licensing/self-archiving.html

**Current positioning (WO2, what the journal accepts now):** Journal continues to publish across analytic, continental, and history-of-philosophy traditions with explicit pluralism commitment. Recent 2026 issues (per Wiley journal homepage) show heavy continental/phenomenology content: multiple Foucault-related articles (relation to Merleau-Ponty, Jaspers, phenomenology/archaeology), Adorno/critical theory ('Adorno's empiricism?'). Journal also runs an annual invited-paper 'Spindel Supplement' (2025 supplement volume 63 S1 published Sept 2025) and an 'Invited Article' track plus a 'State of the Question' review-article series (author-initiated proposals welcomed since 2020) and a shorter 'Notes & Discussion' section (4000-6000 words, for under-studied historical figures or engagement with SJP-published secondary literature).

**Methods noted as welcome (WO2, qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** analytic philosophy, continental philosophy, history of philosophy, phenomenology (heavily represented in 2025-2026 issues, esp. Foucault/Merleau-Ponty/Jaspers), critical theory (Frankfurt School/Adorno), invited Spindel Conference papers/commentaries (annual supplement), author-initiated 'State of the Question' review articles

### AI-Research Notes (WO2 pipeline — sources, blanks, and cross-language checks)

**Sources cited across this entry:**
- https://apasurvey.philx.org/journals/1031 (APA Journal Survey Project, crowdsourced first-hand submission data, n=99)
- https://dailynous.com/2024/01/29/notably-good-experiences-with-philosophy-journals/ (first-hand author comments, English-language academic community)
- https://libguides.iou.edu.gm/c.php?g=1482669&p=11061033 (secondary summary of Wiley publisher-wide policy); https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/20416962/homepage/forauthors.html (journal author guidelines, no AI-specific clause found)
- https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/20416962 (publisher-reported official metrics: 12% acceptance rate, 69-day median first decision, CiteScore 1.4, Journal Impact Factor 0.6)
- https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/20416962 (recent article list, verified 2026-07-13 via live browse)
- https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/20416962/homepage/forauthors.html (submission guideline framing rules)

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **ai_policy.summary (journal-specific text)**: SJP's own Author Guidelines page (onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/20416962/homepage/forauthors.html) contains zero mention of AI/generative AI; only the generic Wiley publisher-wide policy applies, and the primary Wiley policy PDF/pages returned 402/403 errors on direct fetch, so the summary relies on a secondary (LibGuide) source rather than the primary document text.
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: No cross-language or English forum source discusses SJP reviewer culture (political leaning, tone, rigor patterns) with concrete first-hand detail beyond general 'quick and helpful' framing already captured in acceptance_note. Left null per hard rule against inventing generic reviewer-culture narrative.
- **cross_language (Chinese sources)**: 小木虫/fabiaoji/知乎 searches returned zero SJP-specific results — this is an English-language humanities/philosophy journal essentially absent from Chinese academic forums, which skew STEM/social-science and journals relevant to Chinese institutional evaluation (SCI/SSCI-indexed, higher IF). Reported honestly as 0 results rather than omitted.
- **peer_review.type wording confirmation**: Journal guidelines require anonymized submissions ('to ensure anonymous review') but never use the literal phrase 'double-blind' or 'double-anonymous' — type is inferred from the anonymization requirement, not an explicit label, so treat as high-confidence inference rather than a directly quoted policy term.

**Cross-language checks performed (mandatory per WO2 rules):**
- 小木虫 muchong.com — 0 results (SJP not discussed; forum skews STEM/economics)
- 知乎 zhihu — 0 results (only generic English-source journal metadata surfaced, no Chinese-language discussion)
- fabiaoji — not searchable via general web search (no direct results returned; treated as 0 results, could not access site's internal search)
- Reddit r/AskAcademia — 0 direct results for SJP specifically
